description: Unmasks one brand from search_signals on the free plan: its name, domain, store and Ad Library link. Pass the masked row's ref. Spends one of the account's 10 reveals a month (they reset on the 1st; a brand already revealed is free) and needs a signed-in free account. A revealed brand stays unmasked in later searches, and lookup_brand on its domain shows the full brand detail. Paid plans already see every brand.

ref.description: The ref of a masked row from search_signals.

name: reveal_brand
title: Reveal a masked brand
